statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, evolving textile tapestry that juxtaposes organic flow with geometric precision. The composition features thousands of softly flowing fibers that move in subtle, organic patterns across the canvas, creating a sense of depth and movement akin to flowing fabric or liquid. These are contrasted with sharply defined geometric knots that rotate and pulse in place, providing rigid structure against the flowing elements. The interplay between these two contrasting elements creates a living, breathing fabric that shifts and evolves continuously without any user interaction. The visual effect is achieved through particle-based rendering where fibers are drawn as points and knots as rotating 3D shapes, all animated to create a sense of constant motion and transformation.
